description: The bar chart illustrates the accuracy percentages of different reasoning methods, labeled as CoD, CCoT, and CoUT, in a series of tests. The vertical axis represents the accuracy percentage, ranging from 75% to 90%, while the horizontal axis lists the reasoning methods. The CoD method, represented by red bars, shows an accuracy of 91.19%. The CCoT method, depicted in blue, has an accuracy of 88.50%. The CoUT method, shown in green, has the highest accuracy at 676.85%. The values are displayed above each bar, indicating the performance of each method. The chart is designed to compare the accuracy of these reasoning methods without any additional annotations or emphasis on specific bars.
